title: Paul McCartney live: Nobel Peace Prize Concert, Oslo Spektrum, Oslo | 2001
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Oslo Spektrum in Oslo, Norway, on 28 September 1993.

The event was the annual Nobel Peace Prize Concert, held to honour the Nobel Peace Prize laureate. The award ceremony took place the night before in Oslo City Hall, and the concert was broadcast to over 100 countries.

Other performers included Destiny’s Child, Wyclef Jean, and Russell Watson. The finale was a version of The Beatles’ ‘Let It Be’ featuring all the performers.

McCartney had previously performed at the Oslo Spektrum on 27 and 28 September 1993.

Soundcheck setlist

  • ‘Your Loving Flame’
  • ‘Freedom’

Concert setlist

  • ‘Your Loving Flame’
  • ‘Freedom’
  • ‘Let It Be’
